title: The secret is water, not lifting

props.markdown: Let's slice the lock open and replay the climb, one moment at a time.

props.title: Cross-section of the lock, replaying the climb step by step

phases.title: The barge sails in
phases.caption: The chamber is at the level of the lower canal, so its lower gates stand open and the barge glides straight in.

phases.title: The gates close behind it
phases.caption: With the lower gates shut, the chamber becomes a closed basin: its water stays inside.

phases.title: Water flows in from above
phases.caption: Opening the paddles, small sluices in the upper gates, lets water run downhill from the upper canal into the chamber.

phases.title: The boat floats up
phases.caption: As the chamber fills, its surface rises, and the barge floats up with it. Only the water beneath pushes it.

phases.title: Level water, open gates
phases.caption: The chamber is now level with the upper canal. The water pushes as hard on both sides of the gates, so they swing open easily.

phases.title: On its way, 3 metres higher
phases.caption: The barge sails out into the upper canal. The lock never lifted it: the water did.

props.textAlternative:
**Text version of the explanation.** The lock is shown cut along the canal: the lower canal on the left, the chamber in the middle, the upper canal on the right, 3 m higher.

1. **The barge sails in.** The chamber is at the level of the lower canal, so its lower gates stand open and the barge glides in.
2. **The gates close behind it.** With the lower gates shut, the chamber is a closed basin.
3. **Water flows in from above.** The paddles of the upper gates open. Water runs downhill, from the upper canal into the chamber.
4. **The boat floats up.** The chamber fills and its surface rises; the barge floats on it and rises too. Only the water beneath it pushes it up.
5. **Level water, open gates.** When the chamber is level with the upper canal, the water pushes equally on both sides of the upper gates, so they swing open.
6. **On its way.** The barge sails out into the upper canal, 3 m higher than it started.

events.description: Once the last step of the explanation has played to its end, show the button that leads on to the case.
The button leads on to the next screen.
